fusions.name: Long Pursuit Ends
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 30% health for 24 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.2 times their remaining damage to this blow. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Spinning Bola
fusions.desc: Flings a spinning bola that deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Widening Circle
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

fusions.name: Quarry Flagging
fusions.desc: Against a target below 50% health, your damage rises by 12%. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
